statements.chinese: 他是你的兄弟，他是你的大学室友。

statements.english: You know it was just a matter of time before someone had to leave the group
statements.chinese: 你知道有人迟早会离开这个团队。

statements.english: I just always assumed Phoebe would be the one to go
statements.chinese: 我一直以为Phoebe会是离开的那个人。

statements.english: Honey , come on . You live far away , you're not related
statements.chinese: 亲爱的，别这样。你住得那么远，又非亲非故的。

statements.english: You lift right out
statements.chinese: 你可以直接抬起来。

statements.english: Hey , Mr. Bing
statements.chinese: 嘿，Bing先生。

statements.english: That hotel you stayed at called
statements.chinese: 你住过的那家酒店来电话了。

statements.english: Said someone left an eyelash curler in your room
statements.chinese: 有人说在你房间里落了个睫毛夹。

statements.english: Yes , that was mine
statements.chinese: 是的，那是我的。

statements.english: because I figured you'd hooked up with some girl
statements.chinese: 因为我猜你已经和某个女孩好上了

statements.english: and she'd left it there
statements.chinese: 而她把它留在了那里。

statements.english: That would have made more sense
statements.chinese: 那样会更合理些。

statements.english: You know , I don't even feel like I know you anymore man !
statements.chinese: 说真的，老兄，我都觉得不认识你了！

statements.english: All right , look , I'm just going to ask you this one time
statements.chinese: 好吧，听着，我只问你这一次。

statements.english: Whatever you say , I'll believe you
statements.chinese: 无论你说什么，我都会相信你。

statements.english: Were you or were you not ..
statements.chinese: 你到底有没有...

statements.english: ... on a gay cruise ?
statements.chinese: 在同性恋游轮上？

statements.english: Phoebe !
statements.chinese: Phoebe!

statements.english: I'm sorry about the whole " lifting out " thing
statements.chinese: 对于之前说要‘退出’这件事，我很抱歉。

statements.english: You gotta come with me
statements.chinese: 你得跟我来。

statements.english: - Come where ? - Wherever I go
statements.chinese: - 去哪儿？ - 我去哪儿你就去哪儿。

statements.english: You and me , we'll start a new group
statements.chinese: 你和我，我们将组建一个新的团队。

statements.english: We're the best ones
statements.chinese: 我们是最棒的。

statements.english: Okay , but try to get Joey too
statements.chinese: 好的，不过尽量把Joey也叫上。

statements.english: Pheebs , do you mind if I speak to Rachel alone for a sec ?
statements.chinese: Pheebs，你介意我和Rachel单独说会儿话吗？

statements.english: Sure
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Bye , Ross
statements.chinese: 再见，Ross。

statements.english: Forever
statements.chinese: 永远。

statements.english: -Hi . - Hi
statements.chinese: -你好。 - 你好。

statements.english: What are you here ? Isn't this against the rules ?
statements.chinese: 你在这儿干什么？这难道不违反规定吗？

statements.english: I talked to Monica
statements.chinese: 我和Monica聊过了。

statements.english: Look , I'm the one who made the choice
statements.chinese: 听着，做这个选择的人是我。

who.definition: 谁（关系代词的作用说明）

statements.english: I'm the one who's making things change
statements.chinese: 我才是那个推动变革的人。

who's.definition: 谁（关系代词的作用说明）

statements.chinese: 所以应该是我来，你知道的，退一步。

statements.chinese: - Ross。 - 不，不用了，真的没关系。

statements.chinese: 许多人只在感恩节才与姐妹相见...

statements.english: just see their college roommates at reunions ..

statements.english: ... just see Joey at Burger King
statements.chinese: ……就在Burger King见到Joey吧。

statements.english: Is that better ?

statements.chinese: 不，这并没有更好。

statements.english: I still don't get to see you
statements.chinese: 我还是没能见到你。

statements.english: Well , for starters I would've said the right name at my wedding !
statements.chinese: 好吧，首先我本该在我的婚礼上说出正确的名字！

statements.english: I can't believe this happening
statements.chinese: 我不敢相信这正在发生。

statements.english: I know

statements.chinese: 我非常抱歉。

statements.chinese: 我也知道。
